apoapsis.ages.line.2: Iron working confirmed. Expanding fabrication tables.
apoapsis.ages.line.3: Mechanisms online. Grid fabrication and rocketry unlocked: hulls, cockpits, gyroscopes, tanks, engines, fuel.
apoapsis.ages.line.4: First Flight: above 1,500 metres and back down in one piece. Orbital operations begin.
apoapsis.ages.line.start: Age 3 · Current. Build a ship: a cockpit, a tank and a Spark thruster. Fly it above 1,500 m, then land it in one piece.
apoapsis.ages.line.pale: First landing on Pale recorded. A regolith sample brought home to Verdance unlocks the next Age.
apoapsis.firsts.first_flight.line: First Flight logged. The ship came back whole.
apoapsis.firsts.orbit.line: Stable orbit confirmed. Periapsis above the air.
apoapsis.firsts.pale_flyby.line: Pale's gravity has you. Flyby logged.
apoapsis.firsts.pale_landing.line: Boots on Pale. Bring something back.
apoapsis.firsts.pale_sample.line: Pale regolith brought home. Age 5 is open.
